correctionOfRevision1: Revision 1 listed the bus outbox benchmark among the benchmarks that do not measure the product. That is refuted: it drives AddEntityFrameworkOutbox, which is a kept capability. I had folded two different faults into one bucket.

valuableProductScenarioWithAnOutdatedCou.measures: insert through the EF Core bus outbox and the delivery that follows, a kept product capability
valuableProductScenarioWithAnOutdatedCou.whatWasActuallyWrong: its infrastructure: SQL Server over Windows LocalDB, hard coded credentials and search fallbacks, while the referenced SQL transport is PostgreSQL only

notAProductBenchmark.reason: measures BCL Dictionary against ConcurrentDictionary and would stay green with the entire bus deleted
compares against MediatR, a third party library rather than a capability of this product
drives the serializer family that leaves

note: The distinction matters because the two faults have opposite remedies: a wrong counterpart is repaired, a benchmark that measures something else is removed. Treating them alike would have deleted a kept capability from the measurable surface.
